name: Fists Up
description:
When you spend an action to make an unarmed melee attack, you may make one attack per free hand.

When you make an unarmed melee attack or make a melee attack with an improvised weapon, the damage die for the attack is a d6.

Describe how your stripped-down style delivers a brutal blow.

improvements.name: Fists of Fury
improvements.description: Your damage die for unarmed melee attacks and melee attacks with improvised weapons increases to a d8.

improvements.name: Sting Like A Bee
improvements.description: Your damage die for unarmed melee attacks and melee attacks with improvised weapons increases to a d10.
